title: Ateşsan Ambalaj
description: Ateşsan Ambalaj A.Ş. (Ateşsan Oluklu Mukavva) is a long-established, industry-leading manufacturer of corrugated boxes and packaging in Turkey, founded in 1972. Below is a comprehensive overview of the company: 🏢 Company Profile and Scale History: With over 50 years of industry experience, it is one of the earliest corrugated cardboard factories established in Turkey. Production Capacity: Annual output and production capacity reach up to 150,000 metric tons. Facility Area: It operates a 36,000-square-meter enclosed production area. Industrial Strength: Ranked 231st on the “Top 500 Industrial Companies in Turkey” list compiled by the Istanbul Chamber of Industry (ISO). 🏭 Production Facilities and Technology The company operates a large production base in the Marmara Region, primarily consisting of two modern factories: Hadımköy Central Factory (Hadımköy Merkez Fabrika): Located near Arnavutköy in Istanbul, it enjoys a strategic location adjacent to major markets. Gebze Plant (Gebze Fabrika): Located in Gebze, Kocaeli Province. Technological Capabilities: The plants have fully integrated Industry 4.0 (Endüstri 4.0) technologies, implementing fully automated equipment management and highly standardized quality control.
